instruction: Populate res://scenes/main.tscn so Main contains a water depth visualization scene: add a WorldEnvironment with a procedural sky and glow enabled, a DirectionalLight3D with shadows enabled, a MeshInstance3D named Water that uses a 10x10 PlaneMesh subdivided 20x20 with a ShaderMaterial pointing at res://scenes/WaterShader.tres, a Background Node3D holding exactly 5 sphere MeshInstance3Ds at these positions (all within the 10x10 water plane): Sphere at (-3.800, 0.300, 1.200); Sphere2 at (-4.400, -0.500, -0.600); Sphere3 at (-3.200, 0.100, -2.400); Sphere4 at (-2.600, -0.700, 2.800); Sphere5 at (-4.100, 0.400, 3.500), all with green StandardMaterial3D overrides, and a Camera3D positioned at (-0.194, 0.600, 0.048) with a FOV of 110 and all spheres are visible.
